in_marathi.name: Paramanand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Paramanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Paramanand is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Parama’ meaning supreme and ‘Anand’ meaning bliss. This name signifies the attainment of the highest state of happiness and peace.
